defs.def: to give a description of the main facts or points involved in sth 概述；略述

ex.s: Artwork Statement: Please provide a brief statement (maximum 150 words) outlining your artwork concept.
ex.t: 作品阐述：请提供一段简要说明（最多150词），概述你的作品构思。

defs.def: to show or mark the outer edge of sth 显示，勾勒，描画（事物的轮廓）

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

defs.def: a description of the main facts or points involved in sth 概述；梗概

ex.s: You can refer to the outline below.
ex.t: 你可以参考下面的提纲。

ex.s: Use the outline below to help you.
ex.t: 使用下面的提纲来帮助你。

ex.s: Your Outline Outline 1 1 Introduction 2 Dos and don’ts: First ...
ex.t: 你的提纲 提纲1 1 引言 2 应该做和不能做的事：首先……
永远不要＂ 4 完成大纲。

ex.s: I can only "see" through my fingertips the outline of a face.
ex.t: 我只能通过指尖＂看见＂一张脸的轮廓。

defs.def: the line that goes around the edge of sth, showing its main shape but not the details 轮廓线；略图

chunks.cn: 概述在下面 / 概述在…上面 / 概述概述 / 概述介绍
